ending.title: The Offering
ending.beat.1: Three perfect Sweet Tooths, still warm, are set upon the altar.
ending.beat.2: The shop holds its breath. Even the cauldron stops bubbling.
ending.beat.3: Then Sweet Tooth stirs in the dark, and smiles.
ending.beat.4: A sweetness rolls through the hive. One by one, the mice begin to glow... and turn to candy.
ending.beat.5: Nobody minds. The shop opens again in the morning, sweeter than ever. [Placeholder: the real ending is yours to write.]
